bibl.title: Coptic Epitaphs from Abydos.
bibl.seg: Jacques van der Vliet, Coptic Epitaphs from Abydos.
bibl.note: The epitaphs of the "Balyana group". - The epitaphs of the "litany group". - Conclusions. - Texts, Old and New: I. Museo Egizio, Cat. 7130 (Fabretti). Epitaph of a woman [.]aqo. 13 March 946; - II. Cat 7131. Epitaph of a woman Maleu. 26 December 949; - I. Abydos. Copt. (= K.S.B. III, 1534), 1-11. Dedicatory inscription. Between 910 and 921; - Limestone stela; present location unknown, but probably in an Egyptian collection. Epitaph of two priests, Sire and Joseph. 6th-8th cent.
